svg.title: Sparse clipmap cell, eight probe corners, octahedral directions
svg.desc: A query point lies inside one clipmap cell; its eight allocated probe corners are interpolated with trilinear weights. Each probe stores directional radiance in an equal-area octahedral map. Schematic; the captured replay resolves one real query and eight real neighbors.

g.text: Sparse clipmap cell, eight probe corners, octahedral directions
Trilinear space and octahedral direction are two different interpolations; one query uses both.
3D · one clipmap cell and eight probe corners
Sampling is not one exact ray at the cell center.
Σ w_p = 1.000000008 in the replay; parallax is applied per probe.
a used cell without a probe allocates one
32 radiance taps for the captured query
Schematic. The real capture selects cell [24,30,25], probes 54,66,56,68,55,67,57,69; atlas radiance (11.7408, 14.5248, 10.6913).
